keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «둘이 아침에 함께 식물에 물을 준다(하는 일)» 와 «톰은 텃밭 음식이 가장 맛있다고 생각한다(마음)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the action (they water the plants together) and the feeling (Tom thinks garden food tastes the best). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: He thinks food from the garden tastes the best.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: the plants together. Tom pulls out
with the fresh vegetables. Tom thinks garden food tastes the best.

words: a place where people grow plants
a plant you can eat, like a carrot
They water the plants together in the morning.
Tom pulls out weeds, and Grandma picks tomatoes.
plants that grow where you do not want them
At night, Grandma cooks soup with the fresh vegetables.
Tom thinks food from the garden tastes the best.
to be good or bad when you eat it

qs.q: Grandma has a big vegetable garden. What can she do because of it?
qs.qko: 할머니에게는 큰 채소밭이 있어요. 그 덕분에 할머니는 무엇을 할 수 있나요?
opts: She cooks soup with fresh vegetables.
She buys vegetables at the store.
She sells tomatoes in the city.
evs: At night, Grandma cooks soup with the fresh vegetables.
The carrots are orange, and the beans are long.
They water the plants together in the morning.
why: 할머니는 텃밭에서 난 신선한 채소로 수프를 끓여요.
She cooks soup with the fresh vegetables from her garden.

qs.q: "They water the plants." What does "water" mean here?
qs.qko: «They water the plants» 에서 «water» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: They water the plants together in the morning.
At night, Grandma cooks soup with the fresh vegetables.
Tom thinks food from the garden tastes the best.
why: 여기서 «water» 는 «물» 이 아니라 «물을 주다» 예요. 식물에게 물을 줘요.
Here "water" means to give water to the plants.

qs.q: What do Tom and Grandma do in the garden?
opts: They water plants, pull weeds, and pick tomatoes.
They plant trees and build a fence.
evs: They water the plants together in the morning.
Tom pulls out weeds, and Grandma picks tomatoes.
Tom thinks food from the garden tastes the best.
Grandma has a big vegetable garden.
why: 둘은 식물에 물을 주고, 톰은 잡초를 뽑고, 할머니는 토마토를 따요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
They water the plants, Tom pulls weeds, and Grandma picks tomatoes. You need both sentences.

ends: Tom plants his own seeds at home.
Grandma teaches Tom how to cook soup.
할머니가 톰에게 수프 끓이는 법을 알려 준다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>garden food is the best</u> because <u>it is fresh</u>.”

img.cover: Tom, a boy with curly brown hair, a straw hat and blue overalls, and Grandma, a woman with gray hair in a bun and a green apron, stand together in a big vegetable garden with tomato plants, carrots and bean vines.

scenes.1: In the morning garden, Tom, a boy with curly brown hair, a straw hat and blue overalls, waters plants with a watering can while Grandma, a woman with gray hair in a bun and a green apron, picks red tomatoes into a basket; orange carrots and long green beans grow nearby.
scenes.2: At night in a warm kitchen, Grandma, a woman with gray hair in a bun and a green apron, serves bowls of vegetable soup, and Tom, a boy with curly brown hair and blue overalls, eats a spoonful with a happy face.
